root.label: Kennedy Center board and facade name change

events.label: Kennedy Center board and facade name change

slots.name: facade status
slots.sentence: Workers added the president’s name to the building facade but later removed the letters amid the ongoing legal battle.

slots.name: board change date
slots.sentence: Last year, the president fired half of the center’s traditionally bipartisan board, appointed himself as the new chair and handpicked administration allies to serve on the center’s governing body.

slots.name: lawsuit date
slots.sentence: Democratic Rep. Joyce Beatty (Ohio), an ex officio member of the center’s board, sued the Trump administration in December over the proposed name change, calling it a “flagrant violation” of the Constitution.

events.label: Kennedy Center board closes main building for renovations

slots.name: building status
slots.sentence: The center’s board voted last month to immediately close the main building for renovations after officials indicated the center faces “certain fiscal collapse within weeks” and that it is “unsafe for continued occupancy.”
